art: Original vector trims generated using local OFL font outlines. User images used as aesthetic references, not copied as garment graphics.

images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup / physical brand finishing macro photography. Create ONE hyperrealistic close-up photograph of the INSIDE BACK NECK of a warm off-white premium cotton T-shirt laid open on a warm plaster worktable. This is not a paper label: the reference artwork is a small matte CHARCOAL HEAT-TRANSFER NECK LABEL printed directly on the interior cotton, about 60 x 35 mm in total. Preserve the exact simple stacked typography 'OWN' above 'FORM', size 'M' at the right and tiny 'SELF DEFINED / VOL. 01' beneath; use reference image for precise composition. Reference cream background is the unprinted cotton, do not add a rectangular patch or background. Ribbed collar curves across top, neck binding and two rows of imperfect real stitches, visible cotton fibers, slight pilling and soft natural creases. Frame the neckline and label as the clear subject, oblique overhead 85mm macro photo, diffuse side daylight, shallow but usable depth of field so entire label sharp, subtle fine grain, tactile honest fashion production study. Real scale label much smaller than collar opening. No care composition, no country of origin, no certification, no fake QR or barcode. No additional outside captions, hands, brand logos, collage, plastic-looking material or watermark. Square photograph with calm neutral colors.

Use case: product-mockup, physical fashion branding stationery. Photograph a pair of ORIGINAL OWN FORM rectangular BROWN KRAFT CARD HANGTAGS on a raw warm gray plaster surface, one showing front, the other showing reverse. The supplied two reference images are exact PRINT ART, not existing objects: reproduce their layout on the respective tags. Each tag is 55 x 90mm, uncoated medium coffee-brown 350gsm card with readable natural paper fibers, slightly imperfect cut edge, small 3mm punched hole centered near top, dark cotton string loosely looping between them. Front exact text: bracket slash emblem, stacked 'OWN' 'FORM', italic 'Your form.' and 'YOUR RULES.' Reverse exact text: 'SELF DEFINED', original small ASCII flower motif, 'NOT HERE TO FIT IN.', 'DESIGN / OF-02', and small 'WEAR YOUR OWN POINT OF VIEW.' Use one dark charcoal ink only, no white fill, metallic foil or purple; brown paper remains unprinted. Oblique overhead still-life photo, tags gently rotated with clear individual boundaries, no overlap obscuring either main logo, natural soft side daylight, fine film grain, real shadows, material tactile enough to touch. Generous quiet margin, square photo. This is one real-looking photographic scene, not a split layout, graphic design board, collage or mock UI. No invented sustainability certification, recycled percentage, QR code, barcode, additional props, outside captions or watermark.

Use case: product-mockup / fashion detail photography. One hyperrealistic macro photograph of the WEARER'S LEFT SLEEVE of a washed CHARCOAL cotton T-SHIRT, laid on pale gray plaster, showing a tiny acid yellow-green heat transfer brand signature just above the sleeve hem. The supplied reference is the exact sleeve mark only: open left bracket, short diagonal slash, open right bracket, '[ / ]', with original strong geometric shapes. Whole transfer artboard is 40 x 16mm with the actual emblem roughly 32 x 10mm, discreet and physically believable, NOT a large sleeve-wide graphic, no brand name or extra text. Position centered on outer sleeve about 25mm above the double-stitched sleeve edge, with the edge seam running naturally through image. Ink is flat matte acid yellow-green, no stitched patch, no embroidery, no metallic or holographic shine. Show natural charcoal cotton fibers, mineral wash grain, gentle fold tension, slightly irregular stitching, shallow macro depth with emblem and hem sharp, soft natural daylight, fine film grain. Close editorial crop, excellent tactile material realism, square composition. No hands, people, collage, outside captions, QR, badges, other brand or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit / garment branding completion. EDIT reference image 1, preserve the existing charcoal washed NOT HERE T-shirt, shape, camera, warm plaster background, garment color and complete exact central print. Do not redesign main print or alter words. Add ONLY these physical OWN FORM finishing details: (1) a tiny acid-yellow geometric bracket-slash sleeve mark exactly like reference 2, about 40x16mm artboard, on WEARER'S LEFT sleeve (viewer RIGHT sleeve) 25mm above hem; actual emblem discreet, about 32mm wide; (2) a small warm ivory interior neck print visible just inside the open back collar, stacked OWN / FORM, size M, tiny SELF DEFINED / VOL. 01, no sewn patch; (3) attach a realistic small 55x90mm coffee-brown kraft paper hangtag to collar using dark cotton cord. Tag lies on empty plaster beside collar, not covering shirt main graphic, shows exact OWN FORM front from reference 3. Reference 4 shows material and layout of the collar print only, invert charcoal ink to ivory for this dark tee. Keep original shirt and graphic unchanged in size and placement, physically believable photographed transfer ink, cotton fibers, seams, washed texture, natural daylight and soft shadows. Preserve full-garment square composition, whole sleeves and hem visible. No extra badges, fake certificates, QR, watermark, or captions.

Use case: photorealistic-natural / fashion art study. Portrait 3:4 photograph of a stylish adult woman age 29 wearing a premium washed charcoal boxy T-shirt with the exact ORIGINAL ASCII FLOWER artwork in reference 1 on the front. Reference 1 is an original print design: preserve readable character-built petal silhouette and stem, dusty cyan/lilac/sand ink colors, and exact bottom text 'STILL' plus italic 'becoming.'. It must look like a flat MATTE full-color heat transfer on cotton, not a hologram, glowing object, metallic foil or actual reflective material. This explores the visual refraction and text-code mood as ordinary printed color. Maximum artwork 26 x 28 cm, center chest with plenty of blank shirt at sides, not all-over. Tiny ivory bracket-slash OWN FORM mark on wearer left sleeve like reference 2, no extra logos. Woman short dark hair tucked behind ear, calm intense direct gaze, natural skin texture and flyaway hairs, arms relaxed away from print, not tucked across artwork. Loose warm-stone tailored trousers, small silver earrings, refined independent street attitude. Raw pale concrete art-space doorway, worn threshold and imperfect pavement, soft overcast daylight, subtle film grain, full-frame 50mm lens f/3.5, flattering but real human fashion photography. Frame head fully with breathing room and body to mid thigh, print legible, believable cotton drape. No campaign lettering outside garment, no props obscuring print, no watermark, no cigarettes, no other brand names. This is a concept development photo, not a CGI mockup or web interface.
